description.value: Carbone is a glamorous Italian-American restaurant at 181 Thompson St in Greenwich Village, styled like a mid-century red-sauce supper club. Its signature dish is the Spicy Rigatoni Vodka, and tableside service is part of the show. Reservations are famously hard to get, so book as early as possible for dinner.
